attempts.text: [{"name": "buy2buy", "idea": "Item to item table of items carted or ordered together (within 50 events) in the same history session over the last 14 days, counted once per session.", "kind": "table", "level": "item_pair", "sql": "WITH b AS (SELECT session, item, seq FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400 AND event IN ('cart', 'order')), d AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.session, x.item, y.item AS item2 FROM b x JOIN b y ON y.session = x.session AND y.item <> x.item AND y.seq BETWEEN x.seq - 50 AND x.seq + 50), p AS (SELECT item, item2, count(*) AS tv_ns FROM d GROUP BY item, item2), r AS (SELECT item, item2, tv_ns, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY tv_ns DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, tv_ns FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"}]
